title: WILD · Free Turn · 336
style: warm acoustic guitar, soft hand percussion, upright bass, 80 BPM, Spanish female vocals + English male vocals, playful, joyful, bilingual, celebratory but calm, no drill, no phonk
lyrics:
[Intro — soft acoustic, two voices warm]
(ES) Es tu turno. Libre. Sin miedo.
(EN) It's your turn. Free. No fear.

[Verse 1]
(ES) Salimos del taxi, pisamos la calle
(EN) We step from the taxi, we walk the street
(ES) La luna nos guía, la noche nos llama
(EN) The moon is our guide, the night calls our name
(ES) Tres tres seis, contamos la suerte
(EN) Three three six, we count the luck

[Chorus]
(ES) Vuelta libre, vuelta libre
(EN) Free turn, free turn
(ES) Mi casa es su casa, siempre
(EN) My house is your house, always
(ES) Tres tres seis, tres tres seis
(EN) Three three six, three three six

[Verse 2]
(ES) Corey al volante, la sesión es buena
(EN) Corey at the wheel, the session is good
(ES) Risa en la radio, paz en la mente
(EN) Laughter on the radio, peace in the mind
(ES) Aquí no se apura, aquí se respira
(EN) Here we don't rush, here we breathe

[Bridge]
(ES) Si te pierdes, vuelve
(EN) If you get lost, come back
(ES) Si te cansas, descansa
(EN) If you get tired, rest
(ES) Tres tres seis te espera
(EN) Three three six waits for you

[Outro — soft, fading]
(ES) Vuelta libre. Aquí estás.
(EN) Free turn. You are here.
(ES) Tres tres seis. Bienvenido.
(EN) Three three six. Welcome home.
